label: The literal outside-hub scope excludes six sibling packets (mcp-click-up, mcp-figma, mcp-mobbin, mcp-notion, mcp-obsidian, mcp-refero) that live under .skilled/skills/mcp-tooling and that KQ4 called an outside cluster; this question is a strict subset of KQ4.

Rewrite-path class of live outside files: doctor mutation-class manifest, mcp-installers test, playbook fail-closed allowlist, mcp-code-mode _utils.sh README and two playbook catalog rows, sk-code/sk-doc relative cross-references, and generated corpus manifest.

Rewrite-mode-name class of live outside files: seven cli-orca docs, skills index README.txt, compiled-routing canary fixture, system-skill-advisor golden/labeled fixtures, and mcp-code-mode SKILL.md/graph-metadata.json use bare mode ids as route labels or owners.

KQ5 kept the mcp- prefix with folder == workflowMode == packetSkillName, so literal mode ids stay valid and the rewrite-mode-name class is effectively a no-op; path rewrites of the mcp-tooling/ component dominate the outside-hub work.

Generated/regenerate surfaces inside the live classes: system-spec-kit trigger index and corpus manifest, observability report (self-declared Generated 2026-05-03), sk-doc test fixtures and cite-drift-redirects; regenerate rather than hand-edit.

Historical, leave is the largest class by file count: every specs/ research/scratch/review/archive hit, plus changelog and benchmark/reports excluded by the question; the raw repository rg -l overstates the work by an order of magnitude.
The doctor mutation-class guard is the single highest-risk path rewrite: a stale skill_dir silently drops mutation-class coverage, so re-point both values and re-run its test before relocation.

Q10 Lighthouse remains open: the router advertises Lighthouse intent, the feature catalog has no entry, and cli-orca still lists Lighthouse as a Chrome-owned capability; upstream chrome-devtools-mcp/bdg docs must settle it.
